name: European gas (TTF)
summary: European gas near €88/MWh on 25 Nov, above the €70 Alert line and 32% higher over three months
state: Dutch TTF gas settled near €88.1/MWh on 25 Nov, 4.3% higher on the week and 31.5% higher over three months, above the €70 Alert line (Yahoo Finance). It is 15% below its 52-week high near €104. Gulf LNG flows remain constrained as Hormuz crossings run about 40% below early-November levels (Al Jazeera, 24 Nov).
for_you: High wholesale gas prices feed through to energy bills and industrial costs across Europe. Follow Ofgem for UK price cap changes.

sources.title: Yahoo Finance — Dutch TTF natural gas futures (TTF=F)
Al Jazeera — Hormuz oil traffic is down 40 percent: are Iran's tanker attacks working?

why: European gas sets UK and EU power prices and heating bills; Europe has had no cushion since losing Russian pipeline gas.
drivers: LNG supply, storage levels, weather, Norwegian outages, Middle East LNG routes.

rubric.alert: TTF > €70/MWh, or a major supply cut-off (e.g. Qatar LNG or Norway outage > 1 week).
rubric.watch: TTF €40–70/MWh, or storage > 10 points below seasonal norm.
rubric.normal: TTF < €40/MWh and EU storage at or above seasonal norm.
